title: A remote runner's gate result is automatically available as a recognized check on the landing host, bound to the tested tree
outcome: A gate that the standard launcher ran under a satellite root session is admitted automatically on the landing host as a recognized check bound to the tested Git tree, delivered by w-c3f102d77999, so no agent hand-carries evidence.
acceptance: A full gate run under a satellite root session is admitted automatically on the landing host as a recognized check bound to the tested Git tree, with no evidence bundle, per-file hash, import operation or additional agent turn.

The admitted check gates only a landing whose master commit has the tested tree id and whose required plan, platform, toolchain and other applicable checks it satisfies. A focused or whole-bin run cannot satisfy a full-gate criterion. Linux evidence cannot satisfy Windows-specific requirements; a genuine Linux full gate remains eligible where the existing landing policy permits it.
docs/test.md and docs/features/remote-full-gates.md document the automatic path, and tests cover admission and each refusal case.
